Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes below

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Directory Message
Message.Description: A Complex Strategy Directory Message containing the strategy definition will be sent whenever a complex order is added in the system.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal System Tracking Number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily. Valid for trading day

Field.Name: Strategy Type
Field.Description: Strategy Type

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol for the strategy. All legs in this strategy belong to this Underlying

Field.Name: Number of legs
Field.Description: Number of legs in the strategy

Field.Name: Leg Information
Field.Description: Leg Information

Message.Name: Strategy Trading Action Message
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a strategy within the options market.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the Strategy, as defined in the Complex Strategy Message.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the strategy in the options market.

Message.Name: Strategy Best Bid And Ask Update Message
Message.Description: Whenever the best bid and ask position changes on both sides, the options system will send its best bid and ask update via the data feed for the affected strategy.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the strategy, as defined in the Strategy Directory Message.

Field.Name: Quote Condition
Field.Description: Quote Condition

Field.Name: Bid Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregate market size on Bid side.

Field.Name: Bid Price
Field.Description: Best bid price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits

Field.Name: Bid Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the bid side being displayed in the options market at the current time. Does not include the market size.

Field.Name: Bid Cust Size
Field.Description: Customer quantity on the bid side.

Field.Name: Bid ProCust Size
Field.Description: Customer professional quantity on the bid side.

Field.Name: Bid DNTT Size
Field.Description: Aggregated Bid DNTT (Do not Trade Through) Limit Size

Field.Name: Bid DNTT Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregated DNTT (Do Not Trade Through) Market Size on Bid Size.

Field.Name: Ask Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregate market size on Ask side.

Field.Name: Ask Price
Field.Description: Best ask price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits

Field.Name: Ask Size
Field.Description: Aggregated number of contracts on the ask side being displayed in the options market at the current time. Does not include the market size.

Field.Name: Ask Cust Size
Field.Description: Customer quantity on the ask side.

Field.Name: Ask ProCust Size
Field.Description: Customer professional quantity on the ask side.

Field.Name: Ask DNTT Size
Field.Description: Aggregated Ask DNTT (Do not Trade Through) Limit Size

Field.Name: Ask DNTT Market Size
Field.Description: The aggregated DNTT (Do Not Trade Through) Market Size on Ask Size.

Message.Name: Snapshot Message
Message.Description: The Snapshot message reflects the Top of Market Spread Feed sequence number at the time the GLIMPSE spin was requested.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Top of Market Spread Feed sequence number when the Glimpse snapshot was taken. To keep the stream current, process the Top of Market Spread Feed messages beginning with this sequence number.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID for this leg, valid for the trading day. The same ID as the corresponding Option in the Options Directory Message. Zero (0) for Stock Leg.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the option root symbol (security symbol)

Field.Name: Expiration Year
Field.Description: Last two digits of the year of the option expiration

Field.Name: Expiration Month
Field.Description: Expiration Month of the option (1-12)

Field.Name: Expiration Day
Field.Description: Day of the Month of expiration (1-31)

Field.Name: Explicit Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes. Zero (0) for Stock Leg.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates the side of the leg

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg Ratio

Value.Name: Start of Normal Hours Closing Process
Value.Description: Start of Normal Hours Closing Process

Value.Name: Start of Late Hours Closing Process
Value.Description: Start of Late Hours Closing Process
